metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for academic and clinical work: grant review, critical-care consults, citation verification, fabrication auditing, and prompt optimization.

plugins.name: icu-clinical-consult
plugins.description: Multi-agent adversarial critical-care consult. Four independent reviewers (bedside reasoning, guidelines, human pathophysiology, basic science) converge through a synthesizer. Decision support for licensed clinicians.

plugins.name: citation-verification
plugins.description: Verifies every PMID, DOI, PMC, arXiv, and NCT identifier against PubMed, Crossref, OpenAlex, and Semantic Scholar. Replaces anything unverifiable with [CITATION NEEDED].

plugins.name: fabrication-audit
plugins.description: Verification gate for non-citation specifics: doses, thresholds, percentages, guideline names, fees. Classifies every retrievable value by provenance and flags fabrications.

plugins.name: prompt-optimizer
plugins.description: Sharpens a request into a structured 5-element prompt before Claude produces content. Fires on substantive turns, skips trivia, and ships the enforcement hooks.
